name: Stalking the Stalkers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, friend. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.

This type of ferocity will not go unchecked!

You must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!
narrative.objectives:
Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.

Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.
narrative.offerRewardText: A job well done, friend. The Revantusk thank you for your contribution.
narrative.requestItemsText: Show them the might of Revantusk!
